trust_decision.summary: Typed-controller codegen decides how caller-supplied path-param values are spliced into the generated TS URL template; at the pinned commit it inserts them raw (`${path.x}` / `${x}`), so a value can change URL structure (e.g. protocol-relative host) before fetch() sends credentialed headers.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'unescaped path parameters in generated TypeScript client'; grepping for the URL template builder lands directly on build_url_template, the only place path params are interpolated.

fix_sites.entry_point: mix ash_typescript.codegen -> TypedController.Codegen (codegen.ex:288) -> render_no_zod -> render_path_helper (no query args, :74) and render_action_function (:202); generated `xxxPath()` helper and `async xxx()` mutation fetch wrapper
same codegen; render_path_helper for GET routes with query args (:83); generated `xxxPath(path, query)` helper
new shared helper path_param_interpolation covering both :object and :args styles

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Both builders live in the same file next to each other; the only other fetch in generated code (RPC) posts to a static configured endpoint, lib/ash_typescript/rpc/codegen/typescript_static.ex:527.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The variant builder build_url_template_to_variable (route_renderer.ex:396) is used only for GET path helpers with query args, which return a string rather than calling fetch, so a solver could argue path helpers are not a request-redirection sink; the :args style (path_params_style config) is a second, non-default shape a solver could skip.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The `_basePath` prefix and the literal router path segments must stay unencoded (only the param value is encoded), and query args must keep their URLSearchParams handling including `name[]` array appends; an over-broad fix that encodes the whole template or the base path breaks every route.

O6_input_shapes: GET path helper without query args (return template literal)
GET path helper with query args (const base = template)
mutation action function URL passed to executeTypedControllerRequest

O7_producer.where: Path params come from router introspection (lib/ash_typescript/typed_controller/codegen/router_introspector.ex:157-160) which only extracts names, not values; values are runtime caller input in the generated TS.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Phoenix glob segments (`*rest`) are not extracted by `:(\w+)`; a copy that adds glob support would interpolate a multi-segment value where encodeURIComponent would wrongly encode '/' and a naive fix leaves it raw.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Glob routes are a natural feature request for file-download controllers the typed controller targets (agent-docs/features/typed-controller.md:11); the maintainer would need per-segment encoding, a how-type decision.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: String.replace(acc, ":#{param}", ...) matches by prefix, so on a path like /:id/:id_type the ':id' replacement corrupts ':id_type' (param-identity differential); a planted copy could leave the second param raw.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Plain substring replace on placeholders is a common shortcut; parameter names sharing a prefix are common (id, id_type).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A planted runtime URL builder (e.g. a generic `buildRouteUrl(template, params)` helper for dynamic routes or a channel/manifest-driven client) that substitutes params without encoding.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The JSON manifest already exports pathParams for other clients (lib/ash_typescript/rpc/codegen/json_manifest_generator.ex:488), so a second, manifest-driven URL builder is a plausible maintainer addition at distance.

O9_family: open redirect / URL structure injection via unencoded path parameters in generated client (CWE-601)

O10_build.toolchain: Elixir/Erlang OTP with mix; hex deps (ash, spark, phoenix); optional Node/tsc for generated-TS type checks
O10_build.project_tests: test/ash_typescript/typed_controller/codegen_test.exs and base_path_test.exs assert on the generated TS strings; router_introspection_test.exs covers path param extraction

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap `${path.x}` in encodeURIComponent only in build_url_template (the fetch path), leaving build_url_template_to_variable or the :args style raw.
